meta.title: Plugin delivery workflow
meta.description: Adds the plugin-delivery-workflow skill: a staged workflow with an OPC operation chart for shipping scripts into DSH as plugins, scheduled tasks, or desktop components. The skill carries the intake template, gate criteria, a completion checklist, and the failure modes observed while building the disk-cleanup plugin (unverified defaults, desktop path traps, PowerShell serialization quirks, rollback round-trips). It registers a skill only; it changes no files and runs nothing until that skill is loaded. Disabling the bundle removes the skill; existing plugins and schedules keep working.
